summary: Consolidated the Kanban frontend into the requested single static `index.html` with inline vanilla JavaScript and CSS.

messages.content: Frontend now exactly matches the single-static-file constraint. It retains create, edit, click-to-move, delete, three-column rendering, and uses the completed REST API.
Frontend is ready for end-to-end testing at `/`; all UI code is now self-contained in `static/index.html`.

decisions: Consolidated CSS and JavaScript inline in `static/index.html` and removed the former separate static assets to satisfy the single-file frontend requirement.
Continue using PATCH for edit and status-change mutations, which the backend supports.
